title: STET Exam Protests in Patna, Bihar
summary: Students from the State Eligibility Test (STET) gathered in Patna to protest against the government. They demanded that the STET exam be conducted before TRE-4 recruitment advertisements are released. The protesters also called for the resignation of the current education minister, Samrat Choudhary. The protests began in Delhi and have since spread to Ranchi and now Patna.

title_hi: पटना में STET के अभ्यर्थी सरकार के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन कर रहे हैं
